svg.title: mottori-kit: a workspace for weeks of work with one AI agent
svg.desc: On Monday you tell the agent the plan and it logs one line. The conversation is compacted twice. On Friday the agent still has the plan, and before it deletes anything it shows you one question from the thinking lenses: what was the old pipeline preventing, and is that still needed?
svg.text: A workspace for weeks of work with one AI agent.
